thread:
mari: Heads-up — we just saw a tenant hit a big spike and the invoice preview showed 0 tokens for several POSTs. looks like edge proxy dropped route tags on 429 retries.

dan: Oof. Is that the same spike we saw at 10:12? I saw retries from the ratelimit path.

mari: yes, 10:12. the ingress added `x-route-id` in 2024 rollout but the proxy retry path doesn't reattach it when it replays. so metering events coming from replay path have no route, and console groups them under "unattributed".

jia: quick question — are we sure this is a missing header and not a sampling rule? I pulled a raw event that lacked `route_id` and it also missed `client_tenant` in some cases.

dan: raw events show the proxy sidecar leaves out the `route_id` header during the 429 backoff replay. `client_tenant` comes from edge auth, so those should always be present. looks like two problems: header preservation on retry, and the ingest contract allowing empty route fields.

samir: ops-bot reported: "edge-proxy-retry: replayed request id=rcp-9a2f, status=429 -> 200, route_id missing". stamping that here.

mari: my rough impact estimate: maybe 0.5-2% of daily tokens are hitting replay path during burst windows. but for some tenants with spiky traffic, it creates a large unattributed bucket and hides per-route quotas in console.

jia: action item candidate: 1) fix proxy to forward `x-route-id` on replays asap, 2) add ingress-side fallback to copy route from original trace if available, 3) change ingest schema to tag events with `route_source: edge|replay|unknown` for debugging.

dan: agree. also need to consider backward compatibility for billing: if route_id is missing historically, invoices might differ if we retroactively attribute tokens. prefer not to reprocess historical invoices. we should only forward-fix going forward and add heuristics for preview only.

mari: UI change suggestion: console should surface a "unattributed tokens" card with a button to view raw events (show route_source and trace id) and a tooltip explaining "tokens without route tags are not attributed to route-level quotas". reduces ops tickets.

samir: +1. can we show a quick mitigation in console: when unattributed spikes > threshold, auto-flag and create a ticket to eng-platform?

jia: technical notes for the fix: in proxy retry path, patch in Golang: `req.Header.Set("x-route-id", ctx.Value("route_id").(string))` before replay. also add unit test for header passthrough and e2e that simulates 429 -> replay.

dan: also update metering ingest schema to a non-breaking optional field `route_source` and set default to "edge" for events with `x-route-id`, "replay" when we detect replay header, and "unknown" otherwise. that'll let us filter in dashboards without changing invoice logic.

mari: rollout plan: patch proxy canary to 10% of edge hosts, monitor `metering.unattributed_tokens` metric for drop. if stable for 30m, ramp. add a temporary ingest-side rule that attaches `route_id` from trace when present but mark as `inferred=true`. no invoice changes.

samir: will create a console alert on >5% unattributed spike per tenant for 1 hour. where should alert live? ops or eng-platform?

dan: eng-platform owns the fix but ops should get page for customer-impacting unexplained charge deltas. make it P2.

mari: also need a customer communication snippet for those affected — short note: "We recently deployed an edge retry fix to improve per-route billing visibility. If you see changes in invoice preview, these are due to improved attribution and will not change billed totals for past invoices." legal should approve.

jia: I'll open PR for proxy and ingest schema. tag @dan for billing concerns and @samir for console alert.

samir: I'll draft the console UI copy and add the unattributed-card mock to the design channel.

dan: I'll coordinate with billing-bot to ensure invoices don't auto-recompute for historical data, and add a log entry into audit for any manual adjustments.

mari: thanks all. timeline: PRs today, canary tomorrow morning, monitor 24h, then ramp. I'll post canary link here when ready. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-started: proxy-retry-fix v1.2.3 -> canary hosts (group=edge-canary-3).

billing-bot: invoice-policy: no retroactive rebilling without explicit approval from finance and CS.

mari: saved the action items in the ticket: ENG-4532. closing thread for now, will update once canary metrics roll in.
